annotation.title_clean: Commission Recommendation (EU) 2026/510 of 6 March 2026 on revising the European assessment framework for 'safe and sustainable by design' chemicals and materials
annotation.title_en: Commission Recommendation (EU) 2026/510 of 6 March 2026 on revising the European assessment framework for 'safe and sustainable by design' chemicals and materials
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Recommendation revising the voluntary 'safe and sustainable by design' (SSbD) framework for chemicals and materials. It sets an iterative, tiered scoping, safety, environmental and socioeconomic assessment approach, encouraging industry, Member States and research bodies to use it and share FAIR data. It is not about AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Voluntary SSbD framework creates no new legal obligations
Adds scoping analysis, tiered scenarios and socioeconomic sustainability assessment
Industry, Member States and research bodies encouraged to apply it and share FAIR data
Commission to provide documentation template and monitor uptake in EU-funded R&I
